note: Merced Irrigation District campground on an oak-and-pine slope above Horseshoe Bend on Lake McClure, off Hwy 132 west of Coulterville. The reservoir is often drawn far down, leaving a wide bare shore below the sites. A few sites are under 30 ft (C6 20 ft; C17 and D13 25 ft). --Claude
summary: Horseshoe Bend (Lake McClure, MID): open; Campspot $38 basic / $48 30-amp (no 50-amp tier here; FY2026 schedule's $65 high dropped), $15 second vehicle; 97 sites (90 on Campspot, E1-E7 first-come), 30A W/E and some W/S/E, showers, dump; WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE lakefront -> lakeview recommended (C-loop pads 4-6 m above full pool behind a tree band, day-use swim/picnic area between the other loops and the water); pin sits in the neighbouring private mobile-home block, move ~220 m east; website and phone updated.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE (recommend lakefront -> lakeview; value is --Claude, not --AWH): the closest sites are the C loop's south row (C4-C8, C17, C18, all sold nightly as Basic $38). On Esri imagery and 3DEP their ground is 268-270 m at ~37.6986,-120.2448, the tree line / high-water edge is 263-265 m at ~37.6982 (full pool 867 ft = 264.3 m), so pads sit 4-6 m above full pool ~25-45 m back, behind a continuous band of oaks and pines; the operator's map puts the swim lagoon and picnic area (day use, closed) between the D/C loops and the lake. Fails the open-ground / kayak test; the water is visible over the bare drawdown shore, so lakeview.
PIN: stored 37.70000,-120.24600 sits in the dense private mobile-home block west of the B loop (the map's 'Private Property'); move ~220 m east to the loops' centroid 37.6997,-120.2436.
